# @eduardorenani/atlasjs

> Mode-based agent orchestration on top of XState v5. You build an agent as a set
> of **modes** (one mental state at a time); each mode runs a `behavior` and
> returns a `ModeResult` that either LEAVES the mode (an `outcome`) or STAYS and
> re-runs (a `stay`). XState is an internal dependency — it never appears in this
> API. ESM only, Node >= 20. `xstate@^5` is a peer dependency.

This file is an LLM-oriented API reference. It is dense and complete by design.
Types are the source of truth; signatures below mirror `src/types.ts`.

## Mental model

- A **mode** = one unit of agentic work with a single goal.
- `behavior(args) => Promise<ModeResult>` is the only place work happens.
- `ModeResult` is a discriminated union (mutually exclusive):
  - `{ outcome: "achieved" | "abandoned", payload }` → **LEAVE** the mode. Dispatched by `routes`; each route carries a `target`.
  - `{ stay: "replay" | "waitOnEvent", payload }` → **STAY** in the mode and re-run. Dispatched by `stay`; no `target`.
- A rejected/throwing `behavior` is caught and routed through a synthesized **error** bucket (`routes.error`). Users never return `error`.
- **`start`** is a single activation bit:
  - `start: "run"` (default) — entering the mode RUNS the behavior immediately (a "dry run"; `event` is `undefined`).
  - `start: "event"` — entering the mode PARKS it; the behavior runs only when a declared event arrives (`event` is the event, never `undefined`).
- `stay` semantics:
  - `"replay"` — re-run the behavior NOW (run-mode: no event; event-mode: the same event).
  - `"waitOnEvent"` — re-run when the NEXT declared event (`events`) arrives.
- This unifies what used to be "active" vs "passive" modes: one primitive both does work and waits for input.

## Exports

Runtime: `defineMode`, `defineCompoundMode`, `defineAgent`, `startAgent`, `END`, `RE_THROW`.
Types: `Mode`, `CompoundMode`, `ModeConfig`, `RunModeConfig`, `EventModeConfig`, `CompoundModeConfig`, `AgentConfig`, `ModesMap`, `ModeResult`, `Outcome`, `Stay`, `Routes`, `StayMap`, `RouteList`, `RouteTarget`, `ErrorRouteTarget`, `CompoundContext`, `AgentActor`, `AgentSnapshot`, `AgentInspectionEvent`, `AgentErrorInfo`, `StartAgentOptions`, `JsonValue`, `JsonObject`, `JsonArray`, `JsonPrimitive`, `JsonCompatible`.

## Core types

```ts
type Outcome = "achieved" | "abandoned";            // LEAVE
type Stay = "replay" | "waitOnEvent";               // STAY (re-run)

type ModeResult<TPayload = unknown> =
  | { outcome: Outcome; stay?: never; payload: TPayload }
  | { stay: Stay; outcome?: never; payload: TPayload };

// A single exit. `when(payload)` is an optional guard (deps-free). `target` is a
// sibling mode name or END. `assign` returns Partial<TContext> merged before the
// transition.
type ExitEntry<TContext, TPayload, TDeps = {}> = {
  when?: (payload: TPayload) => boolean;
  target: string | END;                              // RouteTarget
  assign?: (a: { context: TContext; payload: TPayload; deps: TDeps }) => Partial<TContext>;
};

// A continuation (re-run). No target, no when — the behavior already chose it.
type StayEntry<TContext, TPayload, TDeps = {}> = {
  assign?: (a: { context: TContext; payload: TPayload; deps: TDeps }) => Partial<TContext>;
};

// Error route. `when`/`assign` receive the RAW error (unknown). `target` may be
// RE_THROW (re-propagate above the actor; `assign` ignored).
type ErrorEntry<TContext, TDeps = {}> = {
  when?: (error: unknown) => boolean;
  target: string | END | RE_THROW;                   // ErrorRouteTarget
  assign?: (a: { context: TContext; error: unknown; deps: TDeps }) => Partial<TContext>;
};

// Array form ("first match wins, last entry is the default"): non-last entries
// MUST carry `when`; the last entry MUST omit it. `[]` is rejected for these.
type RouteList<E> = readonly [NoWhen<E>] | readonly [WithWhen<E>, ...WithWhen<E>[], NoWhen<E>];

type Routes<TContext, TPayload, TDeps = {}> = {
  achieved: ExitEntry<…> | RouteList<ExitEntry<…>>;   // required
  abandoned: ExitEntry<…> | RouteList<ExitEntry<…>>;  // required
  error?: ErrorEntry<…> | RouteList<ErrorEntry<…>>;    // optional; omitted => re-throw above the actor
};

type StayMap<TContext, TPayload, TDeps = {}> = {       // all optional
  replay?: StayEntry<…>;
  waitOnEvent?: StayEntry<…>;
};
```

## defineMode

```ts
// Run-mode (default): event is TEvents | undefined.
function defineMode<TContext, TEvents extends {type:string}, TPayload = unknown, TDeps = {}>(
  config: {
    start?: "run";
    events?: readonly TEvents["type"][];               // event types this mode may replay/wait on
    input: (a: { context: TContext; deps: TDeps }) => unknown;
    behavior: (a: { input: unknown; event: TEvents | undefined; deps: TDeps }) => Promise<ModeResult<TPayload>>;
    routes: Routes<TContext, TPayload, TDeps>;
    stay?: StayMap<TContext, TPayload, TDeps>;
  }
): Mode<TContext, TEvents, TPayload, TDeps>;

// Event-mode: required `start: "event"`; event is always TEvents (never undefined).
function defineMode<…>(config: { start: "event"; events?: …; input: …;
  behavior: (a: { input: unknown; event: TEvents; deps: TDeps }) => Promise<ModeResult<TPayload>>;
  routes: …; stay?: …;
}): Mode<…>;
```

`input` derives the behavior's `input` from context (+ deps). It runs before each behavior invocation. Keep it cheap and pure.

## defineCompoundMode

A mode containing sub-modes. Children leave the compound by routing `target: END`; the compound's own `routes` then pick the destination in the enclosing scope.

```ts
function defineCompoundMode<TParentContext, TEvents, TCtx, TModes, TPayload = undefined, TDeps = {}>(
  config: {
    context?: { inherit: readonly (keyof TParentContext)[]; local: JsonCompatible<TLocal> }; // optional lexical scope
    initial: keyof TModes & string;
    modes: TModes;                                     // map of defineMode / defineCompoundMode
    output?: (a: { context: <local view>; deps: TDeps }) => TPayload; // payload the parent routes on
    routes: { achieved: …; abandoned: …; error?: … };  // CompoundRoutes (no `stay` — compounds have no behavior)
  }
): CompoundMode<…>;
```

- With `context`, children see `Pick<TParent, inherit[number]> & typeof local`. `local` resets on re-entry (but a persisted snapshot wins on rehydration).
- The compound's outcome bucket is whichever bucket of the EXITING child contained `target: END`.
- `routes.error` omitted on the compound => a child's error END re-throws above the compound.

## defineAgent + startAgent

```ts
function defineAgent<TContext, TEvents, TModes, TDeps = {}>(config: {
  id: string;
  initial: keyof TModes & string;
  context: JsonCompatible<TContext>;                   // must be JSON round-trippable
  events: TEvents;                                     // phantom: pass `{} as TEvents`
  deps?: Readonly<TDeps>;                              // frozen container of external resources
  modes: TModes;                                       // map of defineMode / defineCompoundMode
}): /* opaque XState machine */;

function startAgent<TContext, TEvents>(machine, options?: {
  snapshot?: AgentSnapshot<TContext>;                  // resume a previous turn
  inspect?: (e: AgentInspectionEvent<TContext>) => void;
  onError?: (info: AgentErrorInfo<TContext>) => void;  // fires when a rejection escapes routes.error
}): AgentActor<TContext, TEvents>;                     // { send(event), stop(), getSnapshot() }

type AgentInspectionEvent<TContext> = {
  type: "transition";
  from: string; to: string;                            // dot-joined mode paths (synthetic substates masked)
  context: TContext;                                   // root context AFTER assigns
  awaiting?: readonly string[];                        // present & non-empty only while PARKED; event types that resume
};

type AgentErrorInfo<TContext> = { error: unknown; modePath: string; context: TContext; snapshot: AgentSnapshot<TContext> };
```

`startAgent` is the only runtime boundary; hosts never import from `xstate`. `AgentSnapshot` is opaque — persist `JSON.stringify(snapshot)` and feed it back as `{ snapshot }` next turn.

## Tokens

- `END` (unique symbol) — the ONLY way for a route `target` to leave a `CompoundMode`. The enclosing compound's matching `routes` bucket fires.
- `RE_THROW` (unique symbol) — valid ONLY on `ErrorEntry.target`. Re-propagates the caught error above the actor instead of transitioning; any `assign` on that entry is ignored.

## Hard rules (these are compile errors or runtime throws)

- No `any` in the public API. `TContext` (root and compound `local`) must satisfy `JsonCompatible<T>` (no `Date`/`Map`/`Set`/functions/class methods) — snapshots must round-trip through JSON.
- `routes.achieved` and `routes.abandoned` are REQUIRED on every mode. `routes.error` is optional; when omitted, a rejection re-throws above the actor (never silently swallowed).
- `ModeResult` cannot mix `outcome` and `stay` (enforced via `?: never`).
- `RouteList` array form: non-last entries MUST have `when`; the last MUST NOT; `[]` is rejected for achieved/abandoned/error.
- `target` strings name a sibling in the IMMEDIATE enclosing `modes` map. No dotted paths, no XState absolute (`#`) paths — use `END` to exit a compound. Validated at machine-creation time (`defineAgent`).
- `behavior` is async and pure of XState; all context mutation goes through `assign` callbacks returning `Partial<TContext>`.

## Examples

Event-mode (parks until an event), then a run-mode that does work:

```ts
import { defineMode, defineAgent, startAgent } from "@eduardorenani/atlasjs";
type Ctx = { question: string; answer: string };
type Ev = { type: "ASK"; question: string };

const listening = defineMode<Ctx, Ev, { question: string }>({
  start: "event",
  events: ["ASK"],
  input: () => null,
  behavior: async ({ event }) => ({ outcome: "achieved", payload: { question: event.question } }),
  routes: {
    achieved: { target: "answering", assign: ({ payload }) => ({ question: payload.question }) },
    abandoned: { target: "answering" },
  },
});

const answering = defineMode<Ctx, Ev, { answer: string }>({
  input: ({ context }) => ({ question: context.question }),
  behavior: async ({ input }) => {
    const { question } = input as { question: string };
    return { outcome: "achieved", payload: { answer: await callLLM(question) } };
  },
  routes: {
    achieved: { target: "listening", assign: ({ payload }) => ({ answer: payload.answer }) },
    abandoned: { target: "listening" },
  },
});

const machine = defineAgent<Ctx, Ev, { listening: typeof listening; answering: typeof answering }>({
  id: "qa", initial: "listening", context: { question: "", answer: "" }, events: {} as Ev,
  modes: { listening, answering },
});
const actor = startAgent<Ctx, Ev>(machine);
actor.send({ type: "ASK", question: "What is a mode?" });
```

Self-suspending mode (teach → park for reply → evaluate → replay or leave):

```ts
const socratic = defineMode<Ctx, Ev, P>({
  events: ["MESSAGE"],                                 // run-mode that may replay/wait on MESSAGE
  input: ({ context }) => ({ messages: context.messages }),
  behavior: async ({ event, deps }) => {
    if (event?.type === "MESSAGE") {
      return understood ? { outcome: "achieved", payload } : { stay: "replay", payload }; // re-teach
    }
    await deps.teach(...);                             // dry-run entry: teach
    return { stay: "waitOnEvent", payload };           // park for the reply
  },
  routes: { achieved: { target: "classifying" }, abandoned: { target: "classifying" } },
  stay: { waitOnEvent: {}, replay: {} },
});
```

Multi-turn host (snapshot rehydration):

```ts
async function runTurn(text: string, snapshot?: AgentSnapshot<Ctx>): Promise<AgentSnapshot<Ctx>> {
  let done!: () => void; const ready = new Promise<void>(r => (done = r));
  const actor = startAgent<Ctx, Ev>(machine, {
    snapshot,
    inspect: (e) => { if (e.awaiting?.length) done(); }, // resumed & parked again
  });
  actor.send({ type: "ASK", question: text });
  await ready;
  const next = actor.getSnapshot(); actor.stop(); return next;
}
```

## Gotchas for code-generation

- Every mode needs `input`, `behavior`, `routes`. There is no `{ on: {} }` "passive" mode; to "wait", use `start: "event"` + `events`, or `stay: "waitOnEvent"`. A do-nothing terminal sink = an event-mode with `events: []`.
- A run-mode's `behavior` MAY receive `event: undefined` (the dry-run entry) — narrow with `event?.type === "..."`.
- To re-run a mode, return a `stay` and declare the matching `stay.<key>` bucket; returning `stay` with no matching bucket has no continuation wired.
- Routing decisions that need a dependency belong in `behavior`, not in `when` (which is deps-free).
- Compounds have `routes` (achieved/abandoned/error) but NO `stay` and NO `behavior`.
